dialogues.speaker: Glenfidia
dialogues.text: Thanks for all your hard work, Lady Paimon. I feel so much more efficient now that I've had a little practice. I'm more than ready to take on the rest of the orders by myself!

dialogues.speaker: Glenfidia
dialogues.text: I'm a fast learner. Besides, we're not getting such a crazy amount of orders right now — perhaps the novelty's already worn off.

dialogues.speaker: Glenfidia
dialogues.text: I can handle most of the orders myself, and we shouldn't get rushed off our feet like before.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, Paimon thought she heard some passersby raving about the drinks stand! Paimon bets it'll be super famous soon!
